CadAssistance.subheading: Send a sketch, a photo, or just the dimensions over WhatsApp — our team returns a manufacturing-ready CAD file you can quote and produce right away.

HowItWorks.heading: From upload to delivery.
HowItWorks.intro: Every order follows the same clear path — you send a design, we handle the rest.
HowItWorks.step1Copy: Send us your STL, STEP, DXF, or IGES file with quantity, material, and any notes.
HowItWorks.step2Copy: We identify the right process for your part — 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting, or EDM.
HowItWorks.step3Copy: We route the job to a vetted partner workshop and track it through production.
HowItWorks.step4Copy: Your finished part is quality-checked and delivered back to you.

About.heading: Manufacturing, made simple in Qatar.
About.lead: Gestaltung for Trading and Services is a manufacturing marketplace and inventory platform based in Lusail, Qatar.
About.body1: We connect clients who need parts made with the network of skilled workshops that can make them. You send a design; we match it to the right production method and a capable Qatari workshop, then manage the job through to delivery.
About.body2: Alongside custom manufacturing, we run a store for high-quality mechanical parts and a multi-tenant inventory system that keeps every workshop's and client's data cleanly separated.
About.value1Copy: The right method for every part, not a one-size-fits-all process.
About.value2Copy: Vetted workshops across Qatar, coordinated in one place.
About.value3Copy: Track every job and every item from one bilingual dashboard.

SourcingGaps.intro: Bill-of-materials lines the store couldn't supply, grouped by function. The more projects asking, the higher it sits — a restocking list written by demand.
SourcingGaps.notReady: Gaps aren't recorded yet — run migration 0023 in Supabase.
SourcingGaps.empty: No gaps yet. Every line matched something in the store.

AdminProjects.title: Projects
AdminProjects.intro: Every project on the platform, for diagnostics. Download or copy one project as JSON — everything it holds, including the raw analysis replies. Only API keys are removed.
AdminProjects.noServiceKey: Owner emails need SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY on this server; names from profiles are shown instead.

StoreAttributes.title: Product attributes
StoreAttributes.intro: Typed attributes let a bill of materials match “10 kΩ, 1/4 W, ±5%, through-hole” to a real product. Products without them still appear, but only as weak matches the customer has to check.
StoreAttributes.completenessNote: A product is complete when it has a class and every required field (*).
StoreAttributes.pickClass: Choose a class to see its fields.
StoreAttributes.kitDiscountNote: Applied when a customer buys a whole bill of materials as one project kit. Checkout applies it on the server.
StoreAttributes.unitsNote: Numbers accept k, M, m, µ/u, n, p: “10k” is {example}, “100n” is 100 nF.

Sourcing.title: Sourcing
Sourcing.modeHelp_markup: We set our price over landed cost. Income = our price − landed cost.
Sourcing.modeHelp_mirror: Our price follows the supplier's retail price automatically. Income = the supplier's commission, not price − cost.
Sourcing.belowFloor: Expected income is below the {pct}% margin floor.
Sourcing.noOffers: No supplier offers yet. Customers see “Available on request”.
Sourcing.errorDuplicate: That supplier SKU already exists for this product.
Sourcing.needsMigration: Run migration 0028_suppliers_and_offers.sql in Supabase to enable sourcing.
Sourcing.suppliersIntro: Each product can carry offers from several suppliers. Commission applies to mirror suppliers (income is the commission). Landed overhead is freight, duty and fees on top of the offer cost.
Sourcing.floorHelp: Products whose income % falls below this are flagged.
Sourcing.fxHelp: One per line: USD=3.64. Used for landed cost.

Delivery.requestHelp: Tell us you need it. We use requests to decide what to stock next, and we'll email you when we can supply it.
Delivery.requestSent: Thanks — we've got your request and will email you.
Delivery.onRequestBody: We don't have a supplier lined up for this yet, so we can't promise a date. Request it and we'll come back to you with one.
Delivery.cartOnRequest: Available on request only — remove it to check out, or request it from its page.
Delivery.shippingAtCheckout: Choose faster or cheaper shipping at checkout.
Delivery.cartBlocked: Some items are available on request only. Remove them to check out.
Delivery.errorNoDate: We can't promise a delivery date for this cart yet.
Delivery.splitSummary: First shipment arrives by {early}, the rest by {late}.
Delivery.oneShipment: Ships together, arriving by {date} — {item} sets the date.
Delivery.promiseNote: Dates include supplier lead time, our handling and a small buffer so we can keep them. If a date is going to move, we'll email you before it, never after.
Delivery.promiseKept: If this date is going to change we'll email you before it.
Delivery.settingsHelp: Carrier cost is the real carrier price; the handling fee is shown as its own line. Promise date = supplier lead time + handling days + transit days + buffer.

QuickEntry.title: Quick add
QuickEntry.intro: Pick images from Google Drive, type the essentials, press Enter. Category, class, supplier, lead time and publish carry over to the next product. Images are copied into our storage — Drive links are never used on the site.
QuickEntry.needsMigration: Run migrations 0028 and 0029 in Supabase first.
QuickEntry.pickerNotConfigured: Google Drive isn't connected yet (set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_APP_ID). You can still add products without images.
QuickEntry.pickerError: Couldn't open Google Drive. Check the pop-up wasn't blocked and try again.
QuickEntry.name: Name
QuickEntry.dupTitle: A very similar product already exists in this category:
QuickEntry.dupConfirm: Press Enter again to save it anyway.
QuickEntry.applyAll: Apply category / supplier / lead days to all rows
QuickEntry.error_sku: Couldn't create a unique SKU — try again.
